headline: Anthropic develops cryptographic verification tool for AI-generated text
summary: Anthropic created a cryptographic prototype to identify which specific AI model generated a response without revealing its internal parameters, though computational costs still limit its use.
why: Anthropic is a prominent artificial intelligence research company developing foundational models.
